hooks.command: input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.command // ""' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(npm (install|run|test|build)|pnpm (install|run|test|build)|cargo (build|test|run)|pytest|jest|vitest)'; then [ -z "$TMUX" ] && echo '[Hook] Long-running command: consider tmux for session persistence' >&2; fi; true

input=$(cat); f=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.file_path // ""' 2>/dev/null || echo ''); if [ -n "$f" ] && echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(js|ts|jsx|tsx|mjs|cjs)$' && [ -f "$f" ]; then n=$(grep -c 'console\.log' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ "$n" -gt 0 ] && echo "[Hook] $n console.log in $(basename "$f"): remove before committing" >&2; fi; true
